title: Introduce mergestate-prober and slim release adapter to reduce merge-time regressions
author: Priya Natarajan
release_notes: Add `mergestate-prober` (lightweight Go binary) to detect quiet merge windows and surface noisy PRs before merge
Replace legacy scripts/scripts/release.sh with cmd/releasectl (Go) and declarative releases under /releases
Split presubmit lint into `ci/presubmit/lint-quick.yml` and `ci/presubmit/lint-full.yml` to improve fast feedback
description: Summary: This PR introduces a small, cross-platform Go utility (tools/mergestate-prober) that evaluates merge readiness by inspecting recent CI flakiness, re-run counts, and commit graph churn; it also replaces the brittle shell-based release script with a slim, declarative release adapter (cmd/releasectl + releases/*.yaml). Motivation: We've observed multiple late-stage regressions and noisy merges where intermittent CI flakiness or concurrent rollups caused post-merge rollbacks. The goal is not to gate merges aggressively, but to give maintainers a deterministic signal (and optional auto-quarantine) when a PR lands during high churn or when CI instability is present. What changed: 1) New tool: tools/mergestate-prober - Go binary that aggregates: recent check-run reruns, failure rates for top 5 flaky tests, and a small heuristic for merge collisions (multiple dependent PRs touching the same packages). 2) Presubmit split: ci/presubmit/lint-quick.yml (fast rules: formatting, TS typecheck subset, go vet) and ci/presubmit/lint-full.yml (full linters + slower codegen checks). Jobs are orchestrated so quick checks unblock author feedback quickly while full checks run in a separate lane. 3) Release refactor: remove scripts/release.sh and add cmd/releasectl which reads declarative release manifests in /releases and performs staged artifacts, signing, and publishing steps. The adapter has pluggable backends for hosted vs private deployments. 4) Repo hygiene: remove deprecated .ci/cache-tarballs/ and update pnpm-lock.yaml and go.mod to current minimal supported toolchains. 5) CI actions: bump actions/checkout to v4, switch some runners to ubuntu-24.04 images, and add lightweight caching policy to speed quick-lint. Testing and verification: - Unit tests for mergestate-prober (mocked GH API) - Integration smoke run of releasectl against a dry-run registry - Presubmit CI run (quick + full) passed after two minor fixes. Rollout plan: merge to main behind a short feature-flag (MERGESTATE_PROBER=enabled by default for maintainers). We will monitor the new metric (merge_prober/alert_rate) in the Console for two weeks and opt-in the auto-quarantine behavior only if the signal proves accurate. Related: ENG-1427 (CI stability), ENG-1843 (release reliability).

chore(ci): split presubmit lint into quick/full and wire gating

fix(ci): adjust caching keys for quick-lint to avoid collisions
docs(release): document release manifest format and dry-run instructions
